items.title: Google Sheets QUERY Function: Automatic Reports in One Formula (Beginner Tutorial)
items.description:
Learn the Google Sheets QUERY function from zero: select, where, order by, limit, group by, label, pivot and dates, step by step for beginners. One formula builds a full sales report that updates itself, and every result shown was checked against the same data before publishing.

Chapters
0:00 The result
0:33 How QUERY works
0:52 The practice table
1:10 select: pick your columns
2:03 where: filter rows
3:21 order by and limit: top 3
3:38 group by: totals in one line
4:31 How QUERY reads your query
5:22 label: the full report
5:42 pivot: a pivot table in one formula
6:00 Filter by date
6:37 Bonus: a report you control from a cell
6:59 Common errors
7:37 Pro tip: a report that grows by itself
7:54 Recap

Every formula from the video (data in A1:E13: Date, Rep, Region, Product, Amount; header in row 1):
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, D, E",1)  -  pick columns
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, D, E where C = 'West'",1)  -  text goes in single quotes
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, D, E where E GT 500",1)  -  numbers: no quotes
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, D, E where C = 'East' and E GT= 90",1)
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, D, E where D = 'Mouse' or D = 'Monitor'",1)
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, D, E where D contains 'top'",1)  -  case sensitive
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, D, E order by E desc limit 3",1)  -  top 3
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select C, sum(E) group by C",1)  -  one total per region
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, count(E), max(E) group by B",1)
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, sum(E) group by B order by sum(E) desc label sum(E) 'Total'",1)  -  the full report
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, sum(E) group by B pivot C",1)  -  pivot table
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select B, D, E where A GT= date '2026-11-01'",1)  -  dates: date 'yyyy-mm-dd'
=QUERY(A1:E13,"select D, E where B = '"&H1&"'",1)  -  rep name typed in H1
=QUERY(A:E,"select B, sum(E) where B is not null group by B",1)  -  grows with new rows
(GT = the greater-than sign. YouTube doesn't allow that symbol in descriptions.)

Clause order: select, where, group by, pivot, order by, limit, label.

Common errors:
Unable to parse query string  -  check single quotes, commas and clause order
NO_COLUMN  -  you used a column letter outside your data
#REF! Array result was not expanded  -  clear the cells where the result spills
Blank values  -  a column mixes numbers and text; keep one type per column
